description: This file implements the ShmBuffer class, which manages shared memory buffers for audio data, including handling buffer status and stream identification within the Android Open Source Project's audio connector component.

classes.name: ShmBuffer
classes.description: A class managing shared memory buffers for audio streaming, including status handling and stream identification.

methods.name: ShmBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shared memory buffer with header info, buffer pointer, length, and callback.

methods.name: ShmBuffer
methods.description: Move constructor transferring ownership and state from another ShmBuffer instance.

methods.name: ~ShmBuffer
methods.description: Destructor ensuring the buffer's status has been sent before destruction.

methods.name: stream_id
